# Disruption Joe

Disruption Joe helps talented groups accomplish more through focused, carefully structured working sessions.

Core proposition:

Better Conversations. Better Outcomes. Better Performance.

Joe has spent ten years developing and refining a playbook of structured exercises informed by Google's Design Sprint, Atlassian's Team Playbook, Liberating Structures, and his experience in technology, product, leadership, and business. The sessions unlock knowledge, creativity, and judgment already inside an organization so a group can make meaningful progress on something that matters.

The work may help a group develop clearer understanding, stronger alternatives, more useful decisions, credible commitments, and meaningful progress. It does not make every decision democratic and it does not replace the authority of the people accountable for the decision.

Visitors may begin with one free 30-minute planning conversation. If a session is useful, Joe prepares a tailored proposal, often for one focused, customized session of about an hour. A larger consulting commitment is not required to begin.

Primary homepage destinations:

- Better Momentum: https://disruptionjoe.com/#floor/momentum
- Better Decisions: https://disruptionjoe.com/#floor/decisions
- Better Understanding: https://disruptionjoe.com/#floor/understanding
- Better Possibilities: https://disruptionjoe.com/#floor/possibilities
- Better AI: https://disruptionjoe.com/#floor/ai
- Meet Joe: https://disruptionjoe.com/#meet-joe
- Plan a conversation: https://disruptionjoe.com/contact/
- Thinking Museum: https://disruptionjoe.com/thinking/

Each floor contains rooms organized around recognizable challenges. Visitors can collect challenges and send them as context for a planning inquiry. The website does not diagnose, score, or automatically recommend a consulting program.

Better AI preserves five established conversation paths: Identify the Floor, Establish the Floor, Raise the Floor, Lead the Change, and Push the Frontier. AI is one important application of Thinking Better Together, not a separate business or the definition of all of Joe's work.

The Thinking Museum at /thinking is a separate exploratory experience for Joe's ideas, methods, experiments, and broader body of work.
